title: Blocking host-to-device copies and per-step synchronization in a training data pipeline
authoring_note: Baseline uses DataLoader(num_workers=0, pin_memory=False) and blocking .to()+synchronize per step. Oracle enables pinned memory, non_blocking copies, a small worker pool, and prefetch. Calibrated on a CUDA host: the speedup is modest but real for this memory-bound pipeline.
author: batch-C prototype agent
